      "id": "lem-hom-from-projectives-counts-simple-composition-factors",
      "concern": "Fact F2 says that morphisms correspond to endomorphisms of the simple quotient and therefore 'form a one-dimensional space.' Simplicity alone only gives a division endomorphism ring. The missing justification here is that L(λ) is generated by its one-dimensional highest-weight space, so every endomorphism is scalar. The assertion is correct, but this short argument is implicit in the base case used by the proof.",
      "severity": "gap-a-reader-closes"

      "id": "lem-finite-closed-immersion-derived-coinduction-adjunction",
      "concern": "Step 2.1 uses 'Restrictions of an injective module sheaf to an open subset remain injective, since extension by zero is exact and left adjoint to restriction.' The cited thm-extension-by-zero-adjunction-exactness states this adjunction and exactness only for sheaves of abelian groups. The proof needs the analogous O-module statement. It follows by equipping extension by zero with the natural O-action and checking exactness stalkwise, but that extension of the cited interface is unstated.",
      "severity": "gap-a-reader-closes"
    }
